environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed into an EKS-managed Fargate profile with shared VPC subnet. The subnet has a Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy (applied via Tigera operator v3.25) with a deny-all egress baseline and explicit allowances only for TCP/443 to service CIDR 10.100.0.0/16 and UDP/53 to kube-dns. The policy selector matches pods with label app.kubernetes.io/component=gateway. Additionally, the VPC subnet route table has no route entry for 169.254.170.2/32 link-local range (removed via custom CloudFormation resource during stack deployment), and the task execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/NoMetadataAccess) that includes an explicit Deny on sts:AssumeRole for any resource matching the container credentials provider ARN pattern. The Envoy sidecar proxy (injected via App Mesh) performs header normalization that strips any header value containing bytes 0x0D or 0x0A before forwarding to upstream, configured via an HttpConnectionManager filter with headers_with_underscores_action: DROP and a custom Lua filter for CRLF byte stripping.

config.platform: ECS Fargate on EKS Fargate Profile
config.calico_policy: GlobalNetworkPolicy deny-all-egress with allow TCP/443 to 10.100.0.0/16 and UDP/53 to kube-dns only
config.permissions_boundary: explicit Deny on sts:AssumeRole for container credentials provider
config.envoy_sidecar: App Mesh with HttpConnectionManager headers_with_underscores_action:DROP plus Lua filter stripping 0x0D/0x0A bytes from header values
